name: Hostile Takeover
caption: The self-named pairing of Werewolf Gregorson and Lucifer Magnusson, managed by Cardinal Synn, whose match against the Drunken Phone Call ended in chaos when both opponents were powerbombed through a glass table.

name: Sexual Assault
caption: The self-named pairing of Arron Iron and Ric Beauty, adopted after the pair broke up a match between Hostile Takeover and the Drunken Phone Call.

name: Drunken Phone Call
caption: The tag team of F-Dot and Ryab, billed as "the cult sensations" of Re-RAW; lost their opening match to interference and were later powerbombed together through a glass table.
